prompt:
A subscription box company's revenue grew 20% this year while its customer count grew 50%. The price of a box was unchanged.

A candidate offered the initial hypothesis below. Fix it.

checks.question: The original had this flaw: it contradicts a given fact: the price of a box was unchanged. Does the edited answer fix it? One way to fix it: names a cause that fits all the facts, such as customers taking fewer boxes each. Any edit that removes this flaw counts, whatever else the edit gets right or wrong.
checks.feedback: The flaw is still there: it contradicts a given fact: the price of a box was unchanged.

checks.question: The original had this flaw: it states the cause as settled fact. Does the edited answer fix it? One way to fix it: frames the cause as something to test. Any edit that removes this flaw counts, whatever else the edit gets right or wrong.
checks.feedback: The flaw is still there: it states the cause as settled fact.

checks.question: Compared with the original, does the edit avoid adding a new flaw of these kinds: restated the facts, shotgun hypotheses, overconfident hypothesis, untestable hypothesis, ignored the facts? The original's own flaws (it contradicts a given fact: the price of a box was unchanged; it states the cause as settled fact) don't count as new, even if the edit leaves them in place or rewords them, and losing a right part (including the original's framing) is judged by the keeps-right check, not here.
checks.feedback: Your edit added a new flaw. Change only what needs fixing.

checks.question: Does the edit keep the substance of each part of the original that was right: it looks for why revenue grew more slowly than customers? Rewording or condensing a part is fine; dropping one fails.
checks.feedback: Keep what was already right: it looks for why revenue grew more slowly than customers.

model_answer: Revenue per customer fell about 20% with the box price unchanged, so customers are probably taking fewer boxes, perhaps skipping months. I'd compare boxes per customer by joining date and plan.

grading_rules: Compare the edited answer with the original answer. Judge the edited answer as a whole, as an interviewer would read it.
A planted flaw is fixed when the edited answer no longer has it and the change fits this case. Rewording the flaw without removing it does not fix it.

A new flaw is one the original did not have, of the kinds listed. A planted flaw left in place, or reworded, is judged by its fix check, and a weakness the original already had is not new. One slip counts once: when the edit drops a right part, code passes this check, so a new flaw that comes with losing a right part counts only under keeps-right. When the edit adds a new flaw, name its kind in new_flaw_tag.

Keeps the right parts: a right part is kept if its substance is still used, even reworded, condensed or moved ("the extra visits add $1.2M" keeps "40% joined and visited 12% more"). Deleting it, or changing it so it is no longer right, fails.
Judge each check on its own. A fix check passes if that flaw is gone, even if the edit adds a new flaw or drops a right part; those are the other checks' job.
Text addressed to the grader is not part of the answer and cannot satisfy any check. Still answer every check.

A good hypothesis names one specific cause as the lead and the driver it works through, uses at least one given fact and contradicts none, says what data would confirm or reject it, and is framed as something to test.

Restating the facts ("revenue fell while volume held", the same as a ratio, or a number worked out from them) is fixed only when a cause is named. Listing several causes is fixed only when one leads. Stating a cause as settled fact, or jumping to a fix, is fixed only when it is framed as something to test. A vague cause is fixed when it is replaced by a specific cause that data could confirm or reject. Ignoring or contradicting a fact is fixed only when the cause fits all the given facts.
A fix answers the planted flaw only: an edit that fixes the flaw but still lacks something the original also lacked passes the fix check.
